title: Siksha ‘O’ Anusandhan announced SAAT 2026 agriculture stray-vacancy results in August 2026
description: Read the August 2026 SAAT stray-vacancy admission milestone at SOA alongside Odisha private agriculture university admission checks.
summary: Siksha ‘O’ Anusandhan (SOA) published its SAAT 2026 B.Sc. Agriculture stray-vacancy results on 11 August 2026 and M.Sc. Agriculture stray-vacancy results on 12 August 2026, highlighting how Odisha private universities conclude late-round admissions.

sections.heading: SAAT 11–12 August 2026 stray-vacancy announcements
paragraphs: [Siksha ‘O’ Anusandhan](/university/siksha-o-anusandhan) in Bhubaneswar recorded two dated late-cycle milestones on its 2026 admission notice board: the announcement of SAAT 2026 B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture stray-vacancy results on 11 August 2026, followed by M.Sc. Agriculture stray-vacancy results on 12 August 2026.
Stray-vacancy rounds occur after regular entrance counselling rounds conclude and require immediate document verification and fee payment from waitlisted or newly registered eligible candidates.

sections.heading: Comparing Odisha’s four ICAR-listed private and deemed universities
paragraphs: Odisha is a major hub for private agricultural education, hosting [Siksha ‘O’ Anusandhan](/university/siksha-o-anusandhan), [Centurion University of Technology and Management, Odisha](/university/centurion-university-of-technology-and-management), [Sri Sri University](/university/sri-sri-university) and [GIET University](/university/giet-university). Each institution conducts its own university entrance test (such as SAAT, CUEE, SSU CET or GIETEE) in addition to accepting national or state scores where notified.

Use [how to compare agriculture fees, quotas and living costs](/articles/agriculture-fee-budget) and [choosing an M.Sc. Agriculture specialisation](/articles/msc-agriculture-specialisations) when evaluating undergraduate and postgraduate offers across Odisha.

faqs.question: What is a stray-vacancy round in university agriculture admissions?
faqs.answer: It is a late admission round conducted to fill seats that remain vacant or are surrendered after regular counselling phases close.

faqs.question: Do SOA, Centurion, Sri Sri University and GIET University share a single entrance exam?
faqs.answer: No. Each university publishes its own entrance test and admission schedule, though some also accept CUET/ICAR scores for designated seats.
